#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# This script checks if the ports are listening and responds to connection attempts

# Define the ports to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)

# Function to check if a port is responsive
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    echo -n "Checking port $port... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port using netcat
    # -z means zero-I/O mode (just scan)
    # -w specifies timeout in seconds
    if nc -z -w 2 $port; then
        echo "OK"
        return 0
    else
        echo "FAILED"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if a port is listening
is_port_listening() {
    local port=$1
    # Check if the port is listening using lsof
    if lsof -i :$port | grep LISTEN > /dev/null; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main health check logic
main() {
    echo "Starting service health check..."
    echo "-----------------------------"
    
    # Initialize status counters
    TOTAL_PORTS=${#PORTS[@]}
    HEALTHY_COUNT=0
    
    # Check each port
    for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
        echo "Service on port $port:"
        
        # Check if port is listening
        if is_port_listening $port; then
            echo "  Port is listening"
            # Check if port responds
            if check_port $port; then
                ((HEALTHY_COUNT++))
                echo "  Status: UP"
            else
                echo "  Status: NOT RESPONDING"
            fi
        else
            echo "  Port is NOT LISTENING"
            echo "  Status: DOWN"
        fi
        echo
    done
    
    # Print summary
    echo "-----------------------------"
    echo "Health check summary:"
    echo "  Total services checked: $TOTAL_PORTS"
    echo "  Healthy services:     $HEALTHY_COUNT"
    echo "  Unhealthy services:   $((TOTAL_PORTS - HEALTHY_COUNT))"
    
    # Determine overall status
    if [ $HEALTHY_COUNT -eq $TOTAL_PORTS ]; then
        echo "Overall status: HEALTHY"
        exit 0  # Success
    else
        echo "Overall status: UNHEALTHY"
        exit 1  # Failure
    fi
}

# Execute main function
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    main
else
    # Allow checking specific port if passed as argument
    if [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        check_port $1
        exit $?
    else
        echo "Invalid argument. Usage: $0 [port-number]"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "$service_name (port $port): DOWN (no response)"
        return 1
    fi

# This script checks if the ports are listening and responds to connection attempts

  local result="DOWN"
  
  # Try to connect to the port using netcat
  # -z: zero-I/O mode (just scan)
  # -w: timeout in seconds

    result="UP"
  fi
  
  echo "$result"
}

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  status=$(check_port $port)
  if [ "$status" == "UP" ]; then
    echo "Port $port: ✅ $status"
  else
    echo "Port $port: ❌ $status"
    all_up=false
  fi
done

echo ""

# Summary
if $all_up; then
  echo "✅ All services are running normally"
  exit 0
else
  echo "⚠️ Some services are not responding"
  exit 1
fi
